summary: Saint Anne was the mother of the Blessed Virgin Mary and a model of maternal devotion. Her life is celebrated as a witness to faithfulness in family life and prayer.
antiphon_text: Let us remember Saint Anne as a faithful witness to the love and mercy of Christ.
prayer_text: Lord God, through the life of Saint Anne, strengthen us to follow your path with courage and charity. Grant us the grace to bear faithful witness in our own time. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.
